result.brief: 通过 3 万小时自我中心视频系统研究世界模型的可扩展性，发现智能体建模趋于饱和而物体动态保真度提升缓慢，并提出将容量从场景外观转向物体动态的监督方案。
result.reason: Scaling study of ego-centric video world models, evaluating agent/object interaction fidelity and a supervision scheme shifting capacity toward object dynamics; directly informs video world modeling and representation.
